item.title: Masai eyes Paris revival as Kenyan trio chase marathon glory - Breaking Kenya News
item.description: The 2019 Toronto Marathon champion, Magdalyne Masai, will be eager to get her season back on track on April 12 at the Paris Marathon after a disappointing start to the year.
